[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 11::Three years.
]


Against a carrier for compensation for non-delivery of, or delay in delivering, goods.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the goods ought to be delivered.
